feature: Bounded NURBS polyline approximation and closest mesh triangle locations
behavior: Approximation retains native parameters and knot boundaries. Exact rational restriction and Bernstein difference hulls bound continuous positional error, including endpoint rounding.
Common-sign weights, including uniformly negative gauges, reuse the existing certificate engine; source controls and knots remain unchanged.
Mesh closest locations preserve deterministic triangle identity through the existing BVH; the point-only API delegates to the same query.
limitations: Mesh curve tracing across faces and closest-branch discontinuities remains pending; the Pull command still declines mesh curve sources.
Degrees above 16, mixed-sign weights, discontinuities, constant or unresolved closed segments and exhausted parameter or arithmetic precision decline.
The existing certificate engine bounds work, rational bit size and subdivision depth. Tight tolerances and large models may exceed those budgets.
The certificate bounds stored mathematical geometry; floating-point evaluation has its own rounding error. Positional error alone does not certify topology or preserve sub-tolerance features.
No fresh Rhino capture, vertex-count parity or comparative speed qualification is included.
